intent: Task completion as a bar or circle from 0 to 100, or an indeterminate bar when the percent is not known. One piece. Optional name label. Percent overlay, end, or in the ring hole, in Geist Mono. Bar track and fill share radius.controlSm, the same subtle corners as every kit meter. Tones brand, success, warning, danger, muted, neutral. Sizes sm, md, lg. Fill grows once on load.
useWhen: A determinate percent in a form, card, or page
A determinate percent as a ring or semicircle
Work is underway and the percent is not known: indeterminate bar
doNotUseWhen: A short wait with no layout or percent, or a Button action — use Spinner or Button loading
A rating out of 5 — that stays a Cell type
Part-to-whole share across segments — use PieChart
Numbered wizard or checkout steps — use ProgressSteps
Usage against a plan limit — use UsageList
A measure against a range with red, amber, and green zones, a datatip, or reference lines — use Meter

size.note: Bar track height (corners radius.controlSm, fill matches): sm is space-1, md is space-2, lg is space-3. Overlay uses space-5. Circle and semicircle: sm 56, md 96, lg 196.

shape.note: bar is the track. circle is a donut ring. semicircle is a bottom U gauge: 0 to 100 maps onto 180 degrees, not a cropped 360 degree ring. Same piece. Size sets the ring, not bar height.

label.note: Visible name above the track. Prefer this over ProgressLabel.

showValue.note: Shows the rounded percent. Overlay sits on the bar. End sits after the bar, or in meta when a name label is set. Circle puts it in the hole. Semicircle puts it in the bowl. Percent text is Geist Mono with tabular figures.

valuePosition.note: Bar only. overlay centers the percent on the track. end puts it after the bar, or opposite a name label in the meta row. Circle uses the hole. Semicircle uses the bowl.

tone.note: success is a finished or healthy result. muted is an ink fill; neutral is a mid grey for a value that carries no judgement.

indeterminate.note: Bar only (a ring shape falls back to the bar). A third of the track slides across. value and showValue are ignored, and aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext are left off. Reduced motion: a faint still fill.

ariaLabel.note: Required when label is omitted. Cell passes the percent or its label.

requirements: role=progressbar on the track or ring
Determinate: aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax 100, aria-valuenow rounded percent, aria-valuetext '{n}%'
Indeterminate: aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax only, no aria-valuenow; the unnamed default is Loading
Visible label uses aria-labelledby; unlabeled needs ariaLabel
Reduced motion: no grow-in and no slide; the indeterminate bar is a faint still fill

doNot: Do not invent ProgressLabel, ProgressValue, ProgressTrack, ProgressIndicator, or ProgressRoot
Do not invent MeterCircle or ProgressCircle
Do not use PieChart for a determinate percent ring
Do not use img assets for the ring
Do not add threshold-zone rings, datatip, or reference lines — use Meter
Do not use a native progress element
Do not add a multi-segment status bar
Do not use Progress for ordered wizard steps — use ProgressSteps
Do not use Progress alone for usage against a plan limit — use UsageList
Do not skip prefers-reduced-motion on the load animation
Do not round the bar ends
Do not use indeterminate on a ring — use Spinner for a short wait
snippet:
<Progress value={33} />
<Progress value={56} label="Upload progress" showValue />
<Progress value={50} showValue valuePosition="overlay" />
<Progress value={50} showValue tone="warning" />
<Progress value={50} showValue tone="danger" />
<Progress value={50} shape="circle" showValue />
<Progress value={100} showValue tone="success" />
<Progress indeterminate label="Importing invoices" />
